extra_quotes: We evaluate GRADPlace on all 20 designs of the ISPD 2015 benchmark suite [27] using detailed-routing wirelength (DR WL), via count, design-rule violations after detailed routing (#DRVs), and placement and routing runtimes.
All runs use deterministic execution with random seed 3000 on AMD EPYC 9654 CPUs and one NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPU.

Current limitations include H/V-only candidate patterns, fixed weighting schedules, single-seed runs, and evaluation on one benchmark family and routing flow; future work will explore multi-bend candidates, adaptive schedules, and timing-coupled objectives.
